title: Variance It Will Come
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-09-23

Opens [Sir 2](/bible/sirach/2) · [1 Pet 5](/bible/1-peter/5) · [Luke 14](/bible/luke/14) · [Jer 2](/bible/jeremiah/2) · [Sir 33](/bible/sirach/33) · [Eph 5](/bible/ephesians/5) · [Matt 10](/bible/matthew/10) · [Matt 19](/bible/matthew/19) · [Sir 7](/bible/sirach/7) · [Matt 6](/bible/matthew/6)
## Introduction *[[0:53](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=53s)]* We have got a topic for you called variance, it will come. When you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation. Those temptations come from all different avenues: your own mindset and lust, the ones you love, your job, your congregation. Satan will use your own family to pull you away from your husband and from the truth of the Bible, so a husband has to protect his household and a wife has to be on her husband's side. ## Scriptures Opened **[Sirach 2:1](/bible/sirach/2#v1)** *[[1:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=70s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/2#v1) My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. - When I first came into this truth this was a heavy scripture, and it still is. Something to meditate on. - When you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation. The Lord is refining that fine gold, getting all those imperfections out of you. It's not him tempting you; it's your lust being purged up out of you through the word of God. - Those temptations are going to come from all different avenues: from your own mindset, your own lust, from the ones that you love, from your job, from your congregation. - Temptation is always going to be there. But don't look at it in a bad way. Look at it as correction, as beneficial, as something to fix you up and prepare you for the kingdom of God.
Reading from a definition of variance, on screen *[[3:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=189s)]* > A lack of agreement or harmony. - Like the scripture says, can two walk together except they be agreed; be not unequally yoked with unbelievers. - Somebody that you love, whether it be your mom, your dad, brother, sister, they don't believe and they're constantly coming against you. That's a lack of agreement or harmony. That's variance right there. > Synonyms: friction, discord, conflict, strife, war, dissent, schisms, division, warfare, dispute, clash, dissonance, disharmony, disunity, hostility. - There will be friction. These are the things that are going to tempt you when you are in your walk with the Lord. - All of these things are going to come clashing against you when you are striving to return unto the Lord. There are going to be obstacles out there that are not aligned with the Lord. But you must be built up in the Lord.
**[1 Peter 5:8](/bible/1-peter/5#v8)** *[[5:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=305s)]* > [8](/bible/1-peter/5#v8) Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour: - Your adversary the devil, your enemy, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. He's going to cause friction, strife, disharmony, disunity, conflict, warfare. He is coming against you to make sure that you remain in sin. - But the Lord is the contrary to that. The Lord is refining you, making sure you're that pure gold, prepared and ready for the battle. So variances will come. There's no doubt about it. You can't get around it. **[Luke 14:26](/bible/luke/14#v26)** *[[6:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=362s)]* > [26](/bible/luke/14#v26) If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple. - Does that mean you're supposed to hate your family that may not be in the truth? No. How is that possible when you are supposed to be the light, like it says in Matthew 5:14-16? You're supposed to be an example to them. - It's not talking about you hating them. It's talking about you hating their ways that go against the Lord, especially if those ways are pulling at you to go against the Lord. That's when you have got to observe the time and have discretion: this is not conducive for me, not beneficial in my walk with the Lord. I must remove myself from this situation, from this particular family member that's constantly trying to get me out of the truth. - Oh, here you go reading that Bible again. Or they're always screwing up their face every time you mention or quote a verse. You have got to pay attention to these red flags. That's Satan looking to devour you, and he's using your loved ones to do it. - Are we saying stay away from your loved ones? Absolutely not; you are to be a light and an example to them. But if they are pulling you out of this truth or always coming against you, then you must protect your soul salvation, and sometimes the only way to do that is to be away. Let them see your light shine from a distance, until finally they come: hey, tell me about this, tell me what you're into. - And his own life also: that goes into all the lust and the wickedness in your mindset that you came up in. Most of us in this truth had a whole different lifestyle. All praises to the Lord, we became that new creature in Christ, but we may not have gotten completely rid of that old lifestyle yet. - You have to hate that old lifestyle. If you cannot hate it, the Lord said you cannot be my disciple, because you will infect yourself and the men and women around you. He's coming to make a righteous, purehearted soul. That's who the Lord is looking for. Precepts: - **[Matthew 5:14-16](/bible/matthew/5#v14)** > [14](/bible/matthew/5#v14) Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. > > [15](/bible/matthew/5#v15) Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house. > > [16](/bible/matthew/5#v16) Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven. You're supposed to be the light, an example to them, so Luke 14:26 is not talking about hating your family. **[Jeremiah 2:33](/bible/jeremiah/2#v33)** *[[9:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=564s)]* > [33](/bible/jeremiah/2#v33) Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways. - Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? We cannot trim the ways of the Lord, because that's what we're following, what we say we believe in, what we have faith in. - I know your mom raised you, your father raised you, your brothers and sisters have been around you your whole life. But if they are constantly pulling at you to go against the Lord, you cannot trim your ways. Otherwise the Lord said he cannot use you; you are not strong enough for him. - The devil don't care who he uses. The devil is going to use whoever he can to make sure that he pulls you out of this truth. You always have got to keep that mindset. - Therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways: I'm glad we kept reading. When you trim your ways to seek love, you are teaching your loved ones, that you want to come into the truth and receive salvation with you, that you don't really believe what you say you believe. You're really showing them that you hate them, and that light you're supposed to be showing them, you're actually showing them darkness. - So no, you have got to remain strong and bold, so they know you're not playing around and they cannot make a mockery of what you believe in. Lord's will, they eventually change and start to make the steps you have already made, because you have been that example and that light unto them. This thing is warfare. This is the conditions of the battle. **[Sirach 33:19](/bible/sirach/33#v19)** *[[11:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=690s)]* > [19](/bible/sirach/33#v19) Give not thy son and wife, thy brother and friend, power over thee while thou livest, and give not thy goods to another: lest it repent thee, and thou intreat for the same again. - Give not thy son and wife, thy brother and friend, power over thee while thou livest. I don't care how much they pull at your heartstrings. Don't give them power over you. - How do you give them power over you? By trimming your ways. Whatever the situation may be in your life, you feel guilty about a certain thing that happened, and they pull on that thing and try to use it for you to break the Sabbath, to not keep the new moon, to not dress in modest apparel. Satan is going to use your family members to pull you away from the Lord. **[Ephesians 5:23-25](/bible/ephesians/5#v23)** *[[12:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=752s)]* > [23](/bible/ephesians/5#v23) For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body. > > [24](/bible/ephesians/5#v24) Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. > > [25](/bible/ephesians/5#v25) Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; - The husband is the head of the wife: the husband is the leader of the wife, the leader of the household. Even as Christ is the head of the church: he is the head of the body of the Israelites, the guide, the protector, the teacher. The same way, the husband is the leader, the protector and the guide of the family, of the wife, of the children. It's the same exact way. - When people come against that, remember variance, it will come. When people don't agree, they will attack your family structure. You as a husband have got to be able to protect your family from those things. - So let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing: when family members come against your marriage in Christ, the wife can't jump on the mother-in-law's side, which is her mother. The wife's mindset should always be the mindset of the husband. What your husband says goes, especially if he ain't saying nothing sinful that's going to lead you into sin. You must be on the side of your husband. - The devil will use family members to pull on your heartstrings, to pull you away from your husband, to pull you away from the truth of the Bible. It's a war out here. - Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church. How do you love them? By guiding them, by correcting them, by teaching them the word of God. Prepare them for the kingdom, just like the Lord came on earth and prepared us for the kingdom by teaching the disciples and the apostles. It's the same way we have got to do with our household as husbands. - But variance will come. The opposition will come, Satan will come, and he's going to use all these tactics to come against you. You have to protect your wife and family, and sometimes that means protecting them from the ones you both love. - For example: you and your wife are about to have a baby and have a whole birth plan, and your mother-in-law or your mother is there disrupting it. Have a plan together: if they start to pull us away from what we planned, they have got to leave. And you as the wife always have got to be on your husband's side, your lord's side. Otherwise they will see that y'all are not unified in the Lord, and they will pull at that. - People think your family won't come against you in this truth. Oh yeah, that's probably the main thing that comes against you. **[Matthew 10:34-38](/bible/matthew/10#v34)** *[[17:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=1032s)]* > [34](/bible/matthew/10#v34) Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword. > > [35](/bible/matthew/10#v35) For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law. > > [36](/bible/matthew/10#v36) And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household. > > [37](/bible/matthew/10#v37) He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me. > > [38](/bible/matthew/10#v38) And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me. - This is the Lord speaking: think not that I am come to send peace on earth. I came not to send peace, but a sword: war against family members, war against your own conscience, your own lust. - To set a man at variance: a lack of agreement or harmony. Against his father: he's in a lack of agreement with what you and your family believe in. The daughter against her mother, because the mother may be in a lack of agreement or harmony with what you believe in. - A man's foes shall be they of his own household. Sometimes it may be your husband or your wife or your children that try to pull you away from the Lord. You can't allow that either. You can't give them power over you either. It's not just the people in the world; sometimes the people in your own household ain't right. But you have got to stick to the word of God. - He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: that's the same thing we read in Luke 14:26. You cannot be his disciple. - He that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me: him that doesn't follow the Lord wholeheartedly is not worthy of the Lord. **[Matthew 19:4-6](/bible/matthew/19#v4)** *[[19:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=1185s)]* > [4](/bible/matthew/19#v4) And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female, > > [5](/bible/matthew/19#v5) And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh? > > [6](/bible/matthew/19#v6) Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder. - Made them male and female: husband and wife. A man shall leave father and mother and cleave to his wife. You and your wife are an army: an army against Satan, an army to raise up your children righteously. - Everything else is outside. If people can't adhere to what you have got going on and are a hindrance to your walk, you must let them go, and sometimes you have got to be an example from a distance. We pray that's not it. I would love for my mother to be in my life, which she is. But if she was to go against this word, I have got to look out for my wife first, my daughter first, my family first. - They twain shall be one flesh: me and my wife are one flesh. - What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder. That man goes into anybody: your mother, your mother-in-law, your father, your father-in-law. You cannot let them come against your marriage. - That's like letting the devil come in between me and Christ. I have built a relationship with him because I'm keeping the law, statutes, commandments and the faith in Christ, but then all of a sudden Satan comes in with the big booty Betty. No, I don't allow Satan to separate me from Christ. It's the same thing; they coincide together. **[Sirach 7:26](/bible/sirach/7#v26)** *[[22:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=1335s)]* > [26](/bible/sirach/7#v26) Hast thou a wife after thy mind? forsake her not: but give not thyself over to a light woman. - When you are one flesh, this is what you're looking for: a wife after your mind. So when you set the rules in your household, nobody can come against that. Say you're at work and the mother-in-law that's in the world wants to come over: your wife automatically knows to tell her, don't come over my house with pants on. - That's why the proving process is so heavy. You don't want somebody that's just going to let a cursed thing into your house, because then you're bringing destruction into your own household. It's a war out here. - Forsake her not: make sure you teach her, guide her, protect her. That is the duty of a husband, the duty of a leader. - But give not thyself over to a light woman: a light woman is one that's going to allow all types of disrespect from the outside world to come into your household. Sometimes you can have light husbands too. Sometimes their mind ain't right either. **[Matthew 6:33](/bible/matthew/6#v33)** *[[23:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=1430s)]* > [33](/bible/matthew/6#v33) But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. - Seek ye first the kingdom of God: the law, statutes and commandments, and the faith of Christ. Studying, praying and applying those things with your family. - And all these things shall be added unto you. The Lord will look out for you when you are on the Lord's side. Nothing's going to be able to come in and disrupt what you have got going on when you are fully rooted in the Lord. ## In Closing *[[24:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4&t=1484s)]* So, I pray that y'all got something out of that. Israel, shalom. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8jMiVrls4g4)
